component.name: Studio
component.summary: Beat rack, timeline and mixer, editable by two people at once

description.p: Studio is an audio editor with a video timeline: an FL-style step rack and piano roll as the generator, a kdenlive-style arrangement as the structure, and a bus mixer — with every edit an operation that undoes, saves and travels to a collaborator by the same mechanism.

ul.li: Automation curves that belong to clips: bind one curve to many clips, move or paste a clip and its ride comes along
Compositions that fold a section to one block; nudge, quantize and align it as one thing
Records vocal takes, tunes them offline or live, exports Opus, FLAC or WAV, and archives a session as one file
One panel at a time on a phone, a workbench on a desktop
